channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Stocks rise, lifted by falling oil and yields as market attempts comeback after Fed sell-off: Live updates
item.description: In a widely anticipated move, the Fed raised the overnight funds rate by a quarter percentage point and signaled another hike could come this year.

item.title: Trump photo appears to reference Kennedy Center demolition, judge orders advance notice of any move to knock it down
item.description: President Donald Trump wants his name on the Kennedy Center. But a judge has ruled it cannot be placed there without authorization by Congress.

item.title: Jensen Huang says Nvidia will sell twice as many chips next year
item.description: Huang's comment is the latest forecast from Nvidia and points to continuing massive growth for the next six quarters.

item.title: As Republicans tout Trump's 'big beautiful bill,' here's who the tax breaks benefited most
item.description: As the midterm elections approach, Republicans are touting President Donald Trump's "big beautiful bill" to voters. Here's who benefited from the tax cuts.

item.title: Securitize jumps after regulators greenlight some tokenized U.S. stock trading
item.description: Securitize surged Thursday after federal regulators greenlit the issuing of tokenized stocks on some trading platforms in the U.S.

item.title: A breakout in the 10-year Treasury yield could hold back stocks if it reaches this level
item.description: "For any yield above 5.25%, equity prices go down," one chief investment officer says.

item.title: JPMorgan oil team gives up on forecasting Iran war endgame as Trump blows past economic redlines
item.description: JPMorgan assumed at the start of the war that several economic redlines would force President Donald Trump into an agreement to open the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: AI needs to have 'reasonable guidelines,' Palantir's Karp tells CNBC
item.description: Palantir CEO Alex Karp called for "reasonable guidelines" on artificial intelligence regulation as tech and policy leaders deliberate over the technology.

item.title: Bill to curb AI data center utility costs hits snag in Senate
item.description: Sen. Martin Heinrich, D-N.M., blocked bipartisan legislation aimed at reining in data center-related utility cost increases, calling the bill a half-measure.

item.title: Amid calls for urgent AI action from Congress, House heads home to campaign
item.description: The urgency with which Anthropic, OpenAI and xAI have sought to be regulated has not translated into action on Capitol Hill.

item.title: OpenAI reports 6 new instances of 'concerning model behavior' since March
item.description: OpenAI has disclosed six new cases of model misbehavior and offered a framework for disclosing future instances, as the debate over AI model safety intensifies.

item.title: A Chinese AI company just connected its model to Wall Street's leading data providers
item.description: The startup Moonshot said it signed on financial industry giants from investment bank CICC to venture capital firms

item.title: GM touts new V-8 engines in revived ‘truck wars’ with Ford, Ram amid lackluster EV sales
item.description: The large, gas-guzzling models continue to sell well in pickup trucks thanks to their ability to tow and haul heavy things.

item.title: Stephen Curry says his Li-Ning signature shoe will debut early next year
item.description: Golden State Warrior superstar Stephen Curry announced in June he was signing a long-term partnership with Chinese brand Li-Ning.

item.title: How record diesel prices will rip through the U.S. economy. Trucks, rails are only the start
item.description: Record diesel prices are already walloping the transportation sector, and if energy prices stay high, the economic impact will spread.

item.title: One cybersecurity stock has lagged of late. Jay Woods says the charts are now turning bullish
item.description: This stock has spent much of the year in Wall Street's penalty box, said the chief market strategist at Freedom Capital Markets.

item.title: Carney says Canada will decide its own partnerships after Trump calls EU proposal ‘laughable’
item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump had described the prospect of Canada becoming the first associate member of the EU as "laughable."

item.title: SEC clears path for tokenized stocks, bringing the market closer to 24/7 trading
item.description: The long awaited Innovation Exemption comes two days after the Senate voted to block the Clarity Act crypto market structure bill from advancing.

item.title: 'Hostile act': Trump threatens EU with tariffs over Canada associate membership proposal
item.description: European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen said EU is opening the door for Canada to become the first associate member of the 27-member bloc.

item.title: Pennsylvania asks for CDC help on measles outbreak, demands agency recognize measles deaths: Reuters
item.description: Pennsylvania ​said it was requesting emergency support from the US CDC as it grapples with one of the country's largest and most deadly measles outbreaks.

item.title: Intel and Micron lead our portfolio higher, and J&J strengthens our case for owning it
item.description: Every weekday, the Investing Club releases the Homestretch; an actionable afternoon update just in time for the last hour of trading.

item.title: Chase celebrates the Sapphire Reserve’s 10th anniversary with new credits and a 5.5 million-point grand prize
item.description: Want to recreate your favorite vacation? A winning Sapphire Reserve cardholder will receive 5.5 million points to do exactly that.

item.title: CoreWeave launches $3 billion convertible debt sale
item.description: CoreWeave said on Thursday it plans to raise $3 billion through a convertible debt offering, highlighting ⁠the funding needed to support its AI infrastructure.

item.title: Trump says U.S. ‘hopefully’ nearing end of Iran war as Saudi Arabia, Houthis trade strikes
item.description: Trump says the U.S. may be nearing the end of its nearly seven-month war with Iran, as he signals Tehran is open to a deal.

item.title: Billionaire Kraft says Ed Sheeran sought $2 million aid donation from him amid fracas over Macklemore's Palestine comments
item.description: Robert Kraft said Ed Sheeran asked him to commit $2 million toward humanitarian aid amid the controversy over Macklemore’s removal from Sheeran’s U.S. tour

item.title: Oil prices fall as Saudi Arabia reportedly offers more crude via Hormuz after pipeline attack
item.description: Oil prices fell as additional Saudi crude supplies eased concerns over disruptions to the kingdom’s exports.

item.title: Trump gains a tariff weapon against China and India. Will he use it?
item.description: U.S. House has paved the way for a legislation that will allow Trump to impose up to 100% tariffs on countries buying Russian oil, giving him leverage against India and China.

item.title: Labor crisis in U.S. chip manufacturing leaves Samsung, TSMC desperate for talent
item.description: U.S. semiconductor manufacturing faces a historic worker shortage as demand soars. Here’s how chipmakers and U.S. universities aim to fix it.

item.title: Bank of England defies Fed’s rate-hike lead, leaving rates unchanged
item.description: The Bank of England kept rates steady Thursday, even after U.K. inflation rose to 3.1% and energy costs put pressure on prices.

item.title: Netflix content chief Bela Bajaria defines event strategy as streamer eyes more live sports
item.description: Bajaria said Netflix would be open to a package of international NFL games if one becomes available when the league renegotiates its media rights agreements.
